_provenance: CAPTURED, not hand-authored: the `params` of one `item/completed` transcript row (id 28745)
a Codex Planner stored on the 4140 instance while working on #2061, read once and copied
verbatim. The model called Codex's built-in `request_user_input_async` tool; the app-server
reports that call as an `agentMessage` carrying `delivery: "async"` and
`questions: [{ title, options? }]`, both EXPERIMENTAL in Codex's schema (#2209 U2).
`threadId` is the real one; the tests substitute their own seeded thread id over it before
emitting the frame, because the run loop drops a frame of any other thread.

item.text:
#2061 正文要求消除未选中时的「100% 占比」，而你消息中的这句话也可能是在指定保留它。是否按 issue 修复：未选中时显示总量，选中切片时显示该切片占比？
- 按 issue 修复，未选中显示总量
- 未选中仍显示「100% 占比」
